## Live geography / route mismatch observed during KOM-18 acceptance — clarified 2026-10-10

Fresh-world live testing found a strategic geography mismatch around North Ithilien:

- A company at **T352 (North Ithilien)** was ordered toward **T351**.
- On the conquest map the two tiles visibly share a border.
- Canonical routing nevertheless treated the destination as **two tiles away**.
- The user also reports **river blockers where there should not be blockers** in this area.

### Canonical design rule clarified by user

For ordinary strategic geography, **if two tiles visibly share a normal border, they should be directly traversable as adjacent tiles**.

A visually touching pair should be non-traversable only when the map/world itself supplies a real geographic barrier, such as an actual mountain barrier/biome or actual river barrier/biome that intentionally blocks passage. The barrier should be understandable from the geography itself, not from an invisible/artificial route rule.

Therefore the correction should fix the underlying geography/adjacency/blocker data so that:
- normal shared borders imply direct adjacency;
- actual mountains/rivers may block an otherwise touching pair where intended;
- false river/mountain blockers are removed;
- rendered borders, canonical raster adjacency and legal route edges agree.

Do **not** preserve a visually touching but secretly non-adjacent pair and solve it only with UI explanation.

Please audit the exact T352/T351 border cells and nearby river/passability metadata. This remains a live observation, not yet a proven raster-vs-route root cause.

## Merge verified — 2026-10-02

[PR #15](https://github.com/daynenewman/KOME-LOTR-Addon/pull/15) is verified merged into dev at [050048409b3769601027133b462f6ab80ed5888b](https://github.com/daynenewman/KOME-LOTR-Addon/commit/050048409b3769601027133b462f6ab80ed5888b). Fresh origin/dev and the clean primary dev worktree both resolve to this SHA; primary advanced by fast-forward only. Reviewed head 4d8e9b5e703c1f45c687239fae8ea2fa29745bb7 is an ancestor and both trees are exactly 18222d72298ab9f9a34f541bc8939261ec2ce6b6. No extra combined changes require a new integration run.

Reused recorded clean test/build: **1,175 passed, two existing Windows symlink skips, zero failures/errors** (1,177 discovered). Not rerun for merge verification; no additional live acceptance claimed. [Committed validation and coordinate/manual handoff](https://github.com/daynenewman/KOME-LOTR-Addon/blob/050048409b3769601027133b462f6ab80ed5888b/docs/tile-geography-review-20261002/README.md). No deployment, branch deletion, world operation or runtime refresh. Other worktrees and protected stash preserved.

Coordinate atlas (26,731 evidence rows / 26,664 unique cells, 43 crops), exact original-source hash/row provenance and approved geometry replay are available on dev. No geometry change or geographic classification was approved by this merge. Uncertain additions, withheld topology/banks/junctions, blocked proposal and optional transfer decisions remain pending; current coordinates and protected controls are in the handoff. Retain In Progress.

Published [PR #15](https://github.com/daynenewman/KOME-LOTR-Addon/pull/15) targeting `dev`; head `4d8e9b5e703c1f45c687239fae8ea2fa29745bb7`. Fresh dev `76fb78e` has no divergence from the reviewed feature base; GitHub reports mergeable. Reported clean test/build: **1,175 passed, two existing Windows symlink skips, zero failures/errors** (not rerun for publication). [Published handoff/evidence](https://github.com/daynenewman/KOME-LOTR-Addon/blob/4d8e9b5e703c1f45c687239fae8ea2fa29745bb7/docs/tile-geography-review-20261002/README.md) and [Claude finding assessment](https://github.com/daynenewman/KOME-LOTR-Addon/blob/4d8e9b5e703c1f45c687239fae8ea2fa29745bb7/docs/tile-geography-review-20261002/claude-review-assessment.md).

Coordinate review package covers 26,731 evidence rows / 26,664 unique cells in 43 regions, with current IDs/gaps, half-open world bounds, protected controls and pending dispositions. [Atlas handoff](https://github.com/daynenewman/KOME-LOTR-Addon/blob/4d8e9b5e703c1f45c687239fae8ea2fa29745bb7/docs/tile-geography-review-20261002/README.md), [compact cells](https://github.com/daynenewman/KOME-LOTR-Addon/blob/4d8e9b5e703c1f45c687239fae8ea2fa29745bb7/docs/tile-geography-review-20261002/review-cells.csv) and [exact provenance verification](https://github.com/daynenewman/KOME-LOTR-Addon/blob/4d8e9b5e703c1f45c687239fae8ea2fa29745bb7/docs/tile-geography-review-20261002/provenance-verification.json): original hashes and every compact coordinate/group/note/source row checked against preserved audits; compact inputs reproduce the atlas, while full provenance replay requires the recorded exact historical originals.

Approved mask remains ab792277f61882d415963bf5af1b8d2705458c68de80f5b3cbb9102e30d1b4a7. No geometry correction, owner/reference change or migration is applied. The 25,919 uncertain V2 additions are concerns, not proven errors; withheld banks/topology, blocked 55-cell proposal and optional (974,727) transfer remain pending explicit decisions. KOM-58 provides an implemented metadata mechanism, but production classifications remain empty. Preserve In Progress and broader acceptance/dependencies.
